sections.text: NAB2 encodes a transcriptional corepressor of EGR-family transcription factors.

sections.text: STAT6 encodes a STAT-family transcription factor involved in interleukin-4 responses.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 6778 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: NAB2::STAT6 joins NAB2 EGR-binding sequences to the STAT6 activation region. In experimental assays the fusion activates EGR1-responsive transcription; it is recurrent in solitary fibrous tumor and shows nuclear localization.

audit_evidence.scope: Fusion detection, domain structure, nuclear localization and EGR1-dependent reporter/proliferation experiments.
